highlights: sold with a sitting tenant paying £450 pcm
summary: Situated in the heart of Ferryhill, this three-bedroom mid-terrace home offers excellent connectivity via the nearby A167, providing swift access northwards to Durham and Newcastle-upon-Tyne, and southwards to Darlington.
description:
Located on the main street just moments from the lively town square, residents will enjoy a vibrant community atmosphere with a wide selection of shops, traditional pubs, cafes, and essential amenities all within easy walking distance. This well-proportioned property presents an excellent investment opportunity, currently tenanted and generating a steady rental income of £450 pcm. The accommodation is thoughtfully arranged over two floors and briefly comprises: a welcoming entrance hall leading into a spacious lounge, a separate dining room perfect for family meals or entertaining guests, a fitted kitchen equipped with ample storage and work surfaces, plus a handy utility space providing additional functionality. Upstairs, the first floor features three generously sized bedrooms, each benefiting from natural light and comfortable heating, alongside a family bathroom fitted with a white suite. Externally, the property boasts an enclosed rear courtyard with secure gated access, offering a private outdoor space ideal for relaxing or dining al fresco.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall is accessed via a UPVC framed double glazed door and features stairs leading to the first floor, complemented by a radiator providing warmth.

LOUNGE

The lounge boasts a UPVC framed double glazed bay window that fills the room with natural light. It features a charming fireplace with an inset and hearth, creating a cosy focal point, and is equipped with a radiator for added comfort.

DINING ROOM The dining room features a UPVC framed double glazed window, allowing plenty of natural light to brighten the space. It includes a radiator for warmth and an under-stair storage cupboard, providing practical storage solutions.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces. It features an inset sink with drainer and mixer tap, plumbing for an automatic washing machine, and space for a cooker. A UPVC framed double glazed window provides natural light, while a door offers direct access to the rear courtyard.

UTILITY SPACE The utility area offers convenient space for a fridge freezer and includes a UPVC framed double glazed window, providing additional natural light.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The spacious landing includes a dedicated area thoughtfully utilised as hanging space, adding practical storage convenience.

BEDROOM ONE

Bedroom one is a comfortable double room featuring a UPVC framed double glazed window that allows plenty of natural light, and it is fitted with a radiator for warmth.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom two is also a good-sized double room, benefiting from a UPVC framed double glazed window and a radiator, providing a bright and cosy space.

BEDROOM THREE

Bedroom three is a comfortable single room featuring a UPVC framed double glazed window and a radiator, perfect for use as a bedroom, study, or home office.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom features a fitted white suite comprising a panel bath, wash hand basin, and WC. The walls are tiled for easy maintenance, and there is a radiator for added comfort. A UPVC framed double glazed window provides natural light and ventilation.

EXTERNALLY

Externally, to the front of the property, there are steps leading up to a forecourt area, offering a welcoming entrance. To the rear, there is an enclosed courtyard with gated access, providing a private outdoor space ideal for seating or storage.
